assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for OUTPOST, a top-down 2D sci-fi outpost defense game. Create a landscape 3:2 aspect ratio game FLOOR BACKGROUND ONLY, orthographic camera looking exactly straight down, no perspective tilt. Entire image is a rectangular abandoned industrial landing pad at night: dark desaturated blue-grey steel and concrete tiled floor, elegant subtle panel seams, worn paint, tiny bolts, discreet cyan inlaid light strips near outer edge, sparse orange hazard paint, just enough handcrafted painterly texture to feel like a polished indie game. Center 85% of the image must be spacious visually quiet flat traversable floor. Outer 5% a low industrial border with small red entrance lights at the EXACT mid-left and mid-right edges; do not put walls across either entrance. Hint of a faded circular signal emblem at the center of the floor. Palette deep navy and cool teal with restrained warm amber edge lights. High craftsmanship, crisp readable details suitable for gameplay on top, no visual clutter or dramatic bright illumination. ABSOLUTELY NO CHARACTERS, NO ENEMIES, NO MACHINES, NO CRYSTALS, NO CRATES, NO MOVABLE OBSTACLES, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO UI, NO LOGOS, NO GRID OVERLAY. The floor is later used under real moving sprites.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite atlas for a high-quality top-down 2D sci-fi indie game, exact 2 by 2 layout on a square image, four equally sized square cells, no cell borders, no labels, fully transparent empty background. All objects use an orthographic camera looking EXACTLY straight down, hand-painted crisp stylized realistic game art, matching deep steel/cyan/amber palette, neutral illumination and NO cast shadow outside object silhouette. Each object fits entirely within its cell leaving at least 10% transparent padding, centered and disconnected from all other cells. TOP LEFT cell: small armored sci-fi engineer/explorer character, viewed vertically overhead with helmet, shoulder plates, two feet, compact backpack, cyan visor highlights, dark slate armor, a compact rifle held at the right side; facing toward the top edge of the image. TOP RIGHT cell: hostile crimson alien beetle/crab with six sharp articulated legs, chitin armor, hot orange eyes, facing toward the top edge, distinct readable silhouette. BOTTOM LEFT cell: a resource deposit cluster of faceted cyan luminous mineral crystals growing from a small dark rock base, top-down visible facets. BOTTOM RIGHT cell: a compact square industrial weapon forge/workbench, steel casing with an amber glowing furnace grille, tools and anvil shape integrated into its top surface, cyan status light; exactly top-down square machinery. All four sprites should be detailed but clear when scaled to 60 pixels in a game. No scenery, no ground, no contact shadows, no lettering, no numbers, no UI, no logos. Real alpha transparency, not a painted checkerboard.
